scope: First complete independent Tinker exact movie review.

lessons.reason: Strong actual shared-parameter credit,token-owned trajectories,rank2/4 projections and precise fresh gates. Ten bounded older completed readouts/role emphasis plus two concrete example-to-voice mappings need repair. Secondary reference panels,schematic destination names,settled holds and compact captions retain deductions.

blockers.detail: TK-ENC-01: Ten bounded new completed-readout families or semantic role emphasis appear before their own actual complete clauses. Independent arithmetic is correct. Preserve the supplied fixtures, already earned outcomes, evolving partial math and strong new precise gates.

TK-ENC-02: Two concrete mechanisms follow different spoken sentences: oversized/empty local probes are each shifted to the following sentence, and artifact expiry occurs during the preceding path-identity explanation.

reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: All three inspected completed receipt permissions pass independently, preserving the adapter/optimizer distinction.
